title: Enrolment
metaDescription: Enrol at Rosehill College, Papakura. In-zone and out-of-zone applications, key dates, required documents and step-by-step enrolment guidance.

sections.heading: Rosehill College Enrolment
sections.lede: We are excited to help you join our thriving learning community. In-zone students apply online; out-of-zone applicants collect an enrolment pack from reception and enter the annual ballot. Enrolments for the following school year typically open at the start of Term 3 each year. For all enrolment enquiries, please email enrolments@rosehillcollege.school.nz.

sections.heading: Returning to Rosehill College?
sections.html:
If your child has previously attended Rosehill College and you wish to re-enrol them, please contact us directly by emailing enrolments@rosehillcollege.school.nz.

We are here to assist you with a smooth and efficient re-enrolment process.

aside.html:
Privacy commitment

We are committed to safeguarding your personal information throughout the enrolment process. For more details, please review our Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: In-zone enrolment
sections.html:
Complete your application online for a fast and straightforward process.

If you do not have access to an electronic device, computers are available at our front office for you to complete your online enrolment. Our front office staff are also available to assist you with the process.

items.title: Before you start
items.html:
We recommend completing your enrolment application online using a desktop computer or laptop, as this provides the best experience.

Before you begin, download and complete the required enrolment forms. These can be filled in electronically using Microsoft Edge or Adobe Acrobat. Save the completed forms, as you will upload them in the Attachments section of the online application.

Submitting an online application does not automatically confirm enrolment. Every application is reviewed, and we will contact you by email once the enrolment process has been completed.

Need help? If you are unable to upload your forms or supporting documents, you can still submit your online application first. The remaining documents can then be emailed to enrolments@rosehillcollege.school.nz, or brought to the school office. Our front office team is happy to help scan documents and add them to your application if needed.

If you would rather complete a paper application, enrolment packs are available from the school office between 8am and 4pm, Monday to Friday.

items.title: Check your school zone
items.html:
Students who live within the Rosehill College enrolment zone are entitled to enrol. If you are unsure whether your address is in zone, simply enter it at the link below.

items.title: Enrolment forms
items.html:
The following forms are required as part of your enrolment application:

  1. Student Health Record
  2. In-zone Enrolment Questionnaire
  3. Education Outside the Classroom (EOTC) Consent Form

All forms must be completed and signed by a parent or legal guardian. Applications cannot be processed until all required signatures have been received.

Before submitting your application, we also encourage you and your child to read The Rosehill College Way. It outlines our expectations for attendance, uniform, behaviour and school life, helping students make a positive start at Rosehill College.

items.title: Supporting documents
items.html:
Please upload clear digital copies of the following documents. PDF format is preferred, although PNG and JPG files are also accepted.

Required documents

  • Student’s Birth Certificate or Passport
  • Student Visa (if the student is not a New Zealand or Australian citizen)
  • Legal or guardianship documents, where applicable — e.g. Parenting Orders, Guardianship Orders, Custody Orders, Protection Orders
  • Proof of address — two different documents, each clearly showing the caregiver’s name, the supply address or rating unit where the student lives (some utility bills show only the postal address on the first page), and the most recent available date:
    • Document 1 (choose one): Tenancy Agreement or Council Rates Bill
    • Document 2 (choose one): Electricity Bill, Water Bill or Gas Bill

Unable to provide proof of address? You must complete a Statutory Declaration confirming your current residential address, signed and witnessed by an authorised person such as a Justice of the Peace. Applications cannot be finalised until acceptable proof of address or a completed Statutory Declaration has been received. For further information or assistance, please contact the enrolment office.

Additional document: the student’s most recent school report.

Naming your files: please name each file as Surname, First Name Document Type — for example, “Smith, John Enrolment Forms.pdf”.

items.title: Confirmation of enrolment
items.html:
Once we have received your application and all required documents, we will review your enrolment. For students who live within the Rosehill College enrolment zone, enrolment will be confirmed once all information has been verified. Processing times may vary during busy enrolment periods.

When your child’s enrolment has been approved, we will send a confirmation by email. Please ensure the email address and phone number provided on your application are correct so we can contact you if we need to.

sections.heading: Ready to apply? In-zone families
sections.text: Once you have read the steps above and prepared your forms and documents, start your online application. Online applications are for in-zone families only — out-of-zone families, please see below.

sections.heading: Out-of-zone enrolment
sections.html:
All out-of-zone enrolment applicants must collect an Out-of-Zone Enrolment Pack from the school reception. Online applications for out-of-zone enrolments are not accepted and will not be processed.

A non-refundable administration fee of $50 is payable when the completed out-of-zone application is submitted. This fee applies to all out-of-zone applications and is not refundable, regardless of the outcome of the ballot process.

sections.heading: How out-of-zone places are allocated
sections.html:
Each year, the Rosehill College Board will determine the number of places likely to be available in the following year for the enrolment of students who live outside the home zone. The Board will publish this information on our school website. The notice will indicate how applications are to be made and will specify a date by which all applications must be received.

Applications for enrolment will be processed in the following order of priority:

  1. First priority: this priority is not applicable at this school because the school does not run a special programme approved by the Secretary for Education.
  2. Second priority: will be given to applicants who are siblings of current students.
  3. Third priority: will be given to applicants who are siblings of former students.
  4. Fourth priority: will be given to any applicant who is a child of a former student of the school.
  5. Fifth priority: will be given to any applicant who is either a child of an employee of the board of the school or a child of a member of the board of the school.
  6. Sixth priority: will be given to all other applicants.

If there are more applicants in the second, third, fourth, or fifth priority groups than there are available places, selection within the priority group will be determined by ballot, conducted in accordance with the instructions of the Secretary under Section 11G(1) of the Education Act 1989. Parents will be informed of the ballot date by notice in a daily or community newspaper circulating in the area served by the school.

Applicants seeking second or third priority status may be required to give proof of a sibling relationship.

sections.heading: Ballot results
sections.html:
The out-of-zone ballot is scheduled to take place on Wednesday 9 September 2026. Parents and caregivers will be notified of the outcome via email shortly after the ballot has been conducted.

If your child is offered a place, please confirm your acceptance within 14 days. Any unaccepted placements will be offered to students on the waiting list in the order their names were drawn.

If you have not received your ballot result after the draw, please contact us for assistance.

Please note: additional ballots may only occur if the Board determines that further places become available during the school year.
